[[File:DragonBanner.png|thumb|The Dragon Banner, used by both Lews Therin Telemon and Rand al'Thor.|250px]]The so-called '''Champion of the Light''', occasionally '''The Light's Champion''',  is a non-diagetic fan term for any one of the souls reborn champion the side of the Light, most likely as part of the end of an Age.

== Overview ==

The [[Age of Legends|Second]] and [[Third Age|Third]] Ages involve the defeat and subsequent rebirth and victory of what has been termed the "Dragon soul" by fans. In the [[Turning]] we read about in the books, this would be [[Lews Therin Telamon]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] respectively. In Ages where a female champion is needed, the role can be fulfilled by [[Amaresu]].{{verify|True, but needs the usual TIDB refs.}}

Since there are seven Ages, there may be may be other (unnamed) souls that perform a similar role, or that named souls we see in the books serve such a role in other Ages. The only thing we know is that the Dragon soul ends at least two Ages and Amaresu at least one.{{verify}} It is not known whether the ends of Ages always involve the Dark One in some way or some other cataclysmic or transformative event. One common theory, for example, is that the [[Tamyrlin|Ring of Tamyrlin]] signaled the end of the [[First Age]] by inventing or discovering [[One Power|channelling]]. Any other possible Champions, however, were not passed down by [[Robert Jordan]].

== Archetypes ==

Robert Jordan envisioned these souls as coming from an archetype, a pattern from which each rebirth is drawn. Each instance of rebirth is different from the others. He used the example of Jesus and King Arthur as being drawn from the same archetype as the Dragon/Dragon Reborn. It is also the case that each archetype has a fixed gender. Amaresu is woven into the Pattern whenever a female champion is needed,{{verify}} which may indicate that the Dragon soul and Amaresu are the only Champions.
